levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع

notes: Two taḥwīl branches (G1 and G2) meet at يحيى; the shared names are written out in each group because the third route (وحدثنيه, after the saying) does not meet them, so no shared tail is used.
The glosses «- واللفظ لزهير -» and «- وهو القطان -» are left out.
«بمثله» is a wording note; the third route is a second isnad of the same saying and is its own group; the Prophet is the end.
«عبد الله» in the third route is Ibn Umar (occurrence 3 of the word in the text).
